issues.title: Narration timing must come from LLM, not calculated from TTS
issues.description: The LLM (brain) should provide authoritative timing for each narration_segment via the 'duration' field.
issues.root_cause: Agent incorrectly added code to recalculate timed_segments by scaling LLM durations based on actual Narakeet audio duration.
issues.solution: Remove _generate_timed_segments() function from tts/generate_audio.py. Player uses LLM's narration_segments[].duration directly.

issues.title: Manim only renders FIRST visual beat - multi-beat rendering not implemented
issues.description: The manim_runner.py previously only rendered the first visual beat for Manim sections.
issues.solution: Added _render_all_beats() function in manim_runner.py that renders each beat as topic_{id}_beat_{i}.mp4.

issues.title: Recap narration only 5 seconds - LLM not generating full recap narration
issues.description: Recap section narration is only 68 chars instead of full narration for all 5 recap scenes.
issues.root_cause: 1) TTS used section-level narration instead of combining recap_scenes[].narration. 2) Prompt examples showed short one-sentence narrations despite 60-100 word requirement.
issues.solution: 1) tts/generate_audio.py now combines all recap_scenes[].narration for TTS. 2) user_prompt.txt updated with full 60-100 word narration examples.

issues.title: Summary slide not displaying in player
issues.description: User reported summary section not appearing in player.
issues.root_cause: CONFIRMED: Player handles summary correctly at lines 60, 416-418. All sections are mapped to slides at line 819. There is NO ALLOWED_SECTION_TYPES filter.
issues.solution: No code change needed. Summary IS included in slides. User may need to navigate to slide #2 to see it, or there may be a different issue.
issues.investigation_notes: Verified player.js - summary is handled. Screenshot shows slide thumbnails include summary. Issue may be user navigation or display issue.
